titel: Turn your rigged figure into printable parts in one click 🔥 | Blender

eind.zin: Elbows and knees stop where your rig stops.

printzin: Measured in Blender, not print tested by us yet.

scenes.tekst: Is your figure still one solid piece?
scenes.label: QUICK QUESTION

scenes.tekst: This robot has a rig, but it is one solid mesh.
scenes.label: BEFORE

scenes.tekst: Select it, and press one button: Figure from rig.
scenes.label: ONE BUTTON

scenes.tekst: It cuts the robot into parts, each with its own joint.
scenes.label: PARTS

scenes.tekst: It reads your rig and lists every joint it placed.
scenes.label: FROM YOUR RIG

scenes.tekst: Elbows and knees get a hinge with an end stop, the rest a ball joint.
scenes.label: HINGE OR BALL

scenes.tekst: Click the lower leg and drag Bend to the stop.
scenes.label: STEP 2

scenes.tekst: Past the stop, red shows where parts would hit.
scenes.label: CHECK

scenes.tekst: Exploded view pulls the parts apart.
scenes.label: LOOK INSIDE

scenes.tekst: Then step three, Fit and export, writes every part as its own file.
scenes.label: STEP 3

scenes.tekst: Exporting is in the free Click Joints too. The one-click figure is Pro.
scenes.label: FREE OR PRO

scenes.tekst: Measured in Blender, not print tested by us yet. Print a test joint first.
scenes.label: HONEST

scenes.tekst: Click Joints Pro. Elbows and knees stop where your rig stops.
scenes.label: CLICK JOINTS PRO
